name: Bagmati
intro: The Kathmandu Valley's seven World Heritage monument zones (the Durbar Squares of Kathmandu, Patan and Bhaktapur, Swayambhu, Boudha, Pashupati and Changu Narayan), the valley-rim hikes and Nagarkot's sunrise, Dhulikhel and Namobuddha, Langtang and the holy lake of Gosaikunda, and the rhinos of Chitwan.
